esp32.detail: 2 pins wired; U2.Analog → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 100 kΩ / 200 kΩ divider on Analog: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the piezo_vibration.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the peak piezo voltage and a knock: passes

pico.detail: 2 pins wired; U2.Analog → GP28 (GPIO28) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 100 kΩ / 200 kΩ divider on Analog: it swings to 5 V, and the GP28 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the piezo_vibration.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the peak piezo voltage and a knock: passes
